Kim — thanks for the clear summary and the draft. Quick answers from our side:

- Activation definition: FinHealth expects the "Activation Date" to be the date when our environment has passed our security checklist and the first production traffic is routed (we call this the feature-flag date). That tends to be ~14 days after the final integration test.
- Invoice timing: Procurement prefers invoice at activation for 30% of the committed value, with the remainder invoiced monthly on net-60 terms.
- PO: We can issue a single PO that references the order form and the MSA; procurement will need a signed order form + invoice schedule before issuing.
- Tax cert: I'll attach our tax certificate (FinHealth_TaxCert.pdf) but will also run a check with tax to confirm whether VAT is applicable for the services.

We have a minor internal ask: can the activation credit be refundable pro-rata if we delay go-live > 60 days? Procurement will push back if there's no clawback language.

I'll loop legal if needed; cc'd procurement on this thread.

Regards,

Thanks Marco — helpful. A couple of notes from Commercial/Legal perspective before we lock the PO requirement: 

1) Refund / clawback: We can accept a refundable activation credit that decays over time — suggested language in the attached PDF sets a 60-day decay window (full refund if cancellation before 60 days; after that, pro-rata credit amortized over 12 months).
2) Activation definition: Suggest we align on a clear checklist (integration tests passed + security acceptance + first production request). I'll ask Solutions Engineering to provide a one-page checklist we can reference in the order form.
3) Net terms: Net-60 for the remainder is acceptable, but finance needs to know whether taxes/VAT will be grossed up or handled by vendor withholding. If FinHealth provides a tax certificate that demonstrates non-VATable status, we'll route invoicing without VAT.

I'm attaching an internal redline (OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf) with the clawback language and a suggested Invoice Trigger table. If you can confirm the PO timing and the acceptance checklist, we can feed this to Legal for a quick MSA/order-form approval.

- Ben
